name: models3d_motion_generate
description: Generate a skeletal animation clip from a movement description with Meshy. No mesh: apply it with `models3d_animate` `motionIdentifier` within 3 days.

creationIdentifier.description: 3D model the clip is for; files it in that model's history.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

prompt.description: The movement, e.g. "a slow bow, then a wave". Max 400 characters.
